Field.Name: BeginString
Field.Description: FIX.4.2 Must be the first field in the message.

Field.Name: BodyLength
Field.Description: Length of message following BodyLength field up to and including the de- limiter preceding the CheckSum (10) field. Must be the second field in the message.

Field.Name: MsgType
Field.Description: Must be the third field in the message.

Field.Name: MsgSeqNum
Field.Description: Sequential sequence number for the session.

Field.Name: PossDupFlag
Field.Description: Indicates a message resent from the admin level (has a duplicate sequence number). Defaults to N.

Field.Name: SenderCompID
Field.Description: ID of sender. Assigned by Cboe for messages sent to Cboe. (TargetCompID (56) for messages from Cboe.)

Field.Name: SendingTime
Field.Description: GMT date and time that message was sent. Microsecond level resolution.

Field.Name: TargetCompID
Field.Description: ID of destination. CEDX for messages sent to CEDX ports. (SenderCompID (49) for messages from Cboe.)

Field.Name: TargetSubID
Field.Description: Sub ID of destination. TEST for messages sent to the Cboe test system. PROD for messages sent to the Cboe production system. (SenderSubID (50) for messages from Cboe.)

Field.Name: PossResend
Field.Description: Possible resend flag. Cboe has special handling for the PossResend for New Order Single messages. See New Order — Single below.

Field.Name: OnBehalfOfCompID
Field.Description: Service bureau use. Identifies end-client on messages to Cboe. Must be identifier known to Cboe. May be used by non-service bureau to specify which clearing arrangement to use if multiple are configured.

Field.Name: OnBehalfOfSubID
Field.Description: End-client sub identifier. Four characters, alphanumeric, otherwise not validated. Recorded and re- turned in DeliverToSubID (129). Available via Drop.

Field.Name: OrigSendingTime
Field.Description: For messages with PossDupFlag (43) = Y, indicates time that message was first sent. Microsecond level resolution.

Field.Name: DeliverToCompID
Field.Description: Service bureau use. Identifies end-client on message from Cboe. Must be Cboe approved identifier.

Field.Name: DeliverToSubID
Field.Description: Returns OnBehalfOfSubID (116) optionally sent by client.

Field.Name: CheckSum
Field.Description: Modulo 256 checksum of all characters in the message up to and including the delimiter preceding the CheckSum field. Three digits with leading zeroes if necessary.

Field.Name: IDSource
Field.Description: Values supported by Cboe: 4 = ISIN Required if Symbol (55) is not set.

Field.Name: LastPx
Field.Description: Price of this fill. May be excluded if using GrossTradeAmt.

Field.Name: LastShares
Field.Description: Quantity of shares traded on this fill.

Field.Name: SecurityID
Field.Description: ISIN if IDSource (22) is set.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Security symbol. See Symbology (p. 5) for additional notes.

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Optional, when TradeReportTransType (487) = 0. Microsecond level resolution.

Field.Name: ExecType
Field.Description: Must be F = Trade

Field.Name: GrossTradeAmt
Field.Description: Total amount traded, expressed in units of currency. Only considered when LastPx is not specified. Supports a maximum of 9 digits before decimal.

Field.Name: TradeReportTransType
Field.Description: Specifies whether this trade report is new or a release. Trades that are currently being delayed from publication can be released for immediate publication. Defaults to ‘new’ if unspecified. 0 = New 3 = Release

Field.Name: TradeReportID
Field.Description: Day-unique ID chosen by client. Cboe will enforce port level day-uniqueness. 20 characters or less. Characters in ASCII range 33–126 are allowed, except for comma, semicolon, and pipe. If the TradeReportID matches a live trade report (one that has been acked, but not confirmed or declined), it will be rejected as duplicate.

Field.Name: MatchType
Field.Description: Where VenueType (1430) = O (offbook), this field models the MMT Level 2 ‘Trading Mode’ field, and must be 3 = Trade Reporting (On-Exchange).

Field.Name: TradeLinkID
Field.Description: Third Party Trade Identifier used for identifying trades coming from a complex package. 30 characters or less. Characters in ASCII range 33–126 are allowed, except for comma, semicolon, and pipe.

Field.Name: TrdType
Field.Description: This field corresponds to the MMT Level 3.1 field ’Transaction Category’. 0 = Regular Trade 2 = Exchange for Physical 65 = Package Trade

Field.Name: TrdSubType
Field.Description: This optional field corresponds to the MMT Level 3.3 field ‘Crossing Trade Indi- cator’. Agency Cross trades may be indicated by setting TrdSubType (829) = 37. Other values are invalid.

Field.Name: TradeReportType
Field.Description: Must be 0 = (Submit)

Field.Name: TradeID
Field.Description: Used to specify a previously reported trade to be released. Mandatory when TradeReportTransType (487) = 3, must be absent when TradeReportTransType (487) = 0.

Field.Name: OrderCategory
Field.Description: This field corresponds to the MMT Level 3.2 field ’Negotiated Transaction Indi- cator’, and is used by the participant to indicate that the trade was a Negotiated Transaction as per the Cboe Rules. For all trade reports reported on-exchange, the value must be 3. 3 = Privately Negotiated Trade

Field.Name: TradeHandlingInstr
Field.Description: Used to specify the trade reporting model used. 0 (Confirmed Trade) 1 (Two-Party Report) 2 (One Party Report for Matching)

Field.Name: TradePublishIndicator
Field.Description: This field corresponds to the MMT Level 4.1 field ’Publication Mode’, and is used by the participant to request that the publication be delayed. Delayed publica- tion/deferrals are ignored if the trade does not qualify for delayed publication. Trades currently being delayed may be released prior to their maximum delay duration using TradeReportTransType (487) = 3. Supported values: 1 = Publish Trade Immediately 2 = Deferred Publication

Field.Name: VenueType
Field.Description: Must be O = OffBook. This field models the MMT Level 1 field ‘Market Mech- anism’.

Field.Name: AlgorithmicTradeIndicator
Field.Description: Indicates that the submitted trade was a result of an investment firm engaging in algorithmic trading. Optional. 0 = No algorithm was involved (the default). 1 = The trade was an algorithmic trade (ALGO).

Field.Name: Tolerance
Field.Description: Maximum allowed delta (in terms of consideration, expressed in the traded cur- rency), that the trade is prepared to match against counterparty. The tolerance should be specified by the buyer in the traded currency of the stock and capped at 5,000 currency units (e.g. 5000 GBX). If the tolerance selected allows for the price submitted by the selling Participant, then it is the price provided by the selling Participant that will be applied to the transaction. Sub-decimal tolerance is not allowed (e.g. 50.20).

Field.Name: IDSource
Field.Description: Copied from the incoming TradeCaptureReport, if present.

Field.Name: LastPx
Field.Description: Copied from the incoming TradeCaptureReport, if present. If GrossTradeAmt was used instead of LastPx, the value here will be indicative. Price is adjusted for allowed precision.

Field.Name: LastShares
Field.Description: Copied from the incoming TradeCaptureReport.

Field.Name: SecurityID
Field.Description: Copied from the incoming TradeCaptureReport, if present.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Copied from the incoming TradeCaptureReport, if present.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: If present, indicates reason for the message. Format is one letter reason code followed by colon and space followed by free form text message. See Reason Codes (§ 12.1, p. 77) for a list of possible reasons.

Field.Description: Unique identifier for the trade report confirm as provided by Cboe.

Field.Description: Contains the TradeReportID (571) of the original trade capture report to which this message relates

Field.Name: MatchStatus
Field.Description: Will be 0 (Matched) for confirm, and 1 (Unmatched) for a decline

Field.Name: TrdSubType

Field.Name: TradeReportType
Field.Description: Will be 2 (Accept) for a confirm, 3 (Decline) for a decline and 0 (Submit) for an unsolicited change.

Field.Name: TradeID
Field.Description: ID representing the trade, as seen on outbound market data. Allocated by Cboe. Required to amend, cancel or release a report. To derive TVTIC (Trading Venue Transaction Identification Code) from an ExecID as needed in Cboe Transaction Reporting, please refer to the Cboe Participant Manual.

Field.Name: OrderCategory
Field.Description: Copied from the incoming TradeCaptureReport, if present.

Field.Name: TradeHandlingInst
Field.Description: Copied from the incoming TradeCaptureReport.

Field.Name: TradePublishIndicator
Field.Description: Will be 2 (Deferred Publication) if deferment is requested and the trade is eli- gible for such. Otherwise, copied from the incoming TradeCaptureReport.

Field.Name: VenueType
Field.Description: Copied from the incoming TradeCaptureReport.

Field.Name: AlgorithmicTradeIndicator
Field.Description: Copied from the incoming TradeCaptureReport , if present.

Field.Name: TrdRegPublicationReasons
Field.Description: If present, indicates the deferral derived by Cboe for this trade. For CEDX, the only valid value is: 6 = Deferral for Large in Scale (LRGS)

Field.Name: RptTime
Field.Description: Indicates the time at which a deferred trade report will be automatically published. Where RptTime falls outside of the systems operating time, the report will be published during operating hours on the next trading day. When no deferral is requested, or when the trade does not qualify for a deferral, any time returned will match TransactTime (60). Microsecond level precision.

Field.Name: OrigCompID
Field.Description: Drop only. TargetCompID (56) of original FIX TradeCaptureReport from Cboe to the Participant. Drop port must be configured to send this optional field.

Field.Name: OrigSubID
Field.Description: Drop only. TargetSubID (57) of original FIX TradeCaptureReport from Cboe to the Participant. Drop port must be configured to send this optional field.

Field.Name: RootPartyID
Field.Description: An identifier for the third party submitting the trade (4 uppercase letters) known to Cboe.

Field.Name: RootPartyIDSource
Field.Description: Acceptable values: D = Proprietary / Custom Code

Field.Name: RootPartyRole
Field.Description: Must be 6 = IntroducingFirm

Field.Name: TradePriceCondition
Field.Description: Optional. Used to indicate values in MMT v3 levels 3.8 For MMT Level 3.8 ‘Contribution to Price Formation or the Price Discovery Process’, supported values are: 15 = Non-Price Forming Trade (NPFT)

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Must be first field in repeating-group 1 = Buy 2 = Sell

Field.Name: Account
Field.Description: Optional. Returned on execution reports associated with this order. 16 characters or less (ASCII 33–126). The value supplied can be passed to the CCP and made available on the Drop feed.

Field.Name: OrderCapacity
Field.Description: Optional. A = Agency (maps to ’AOTC’) P = Principal (maps to ’DEAL’) R = Riskless (maps to ’MTCH’)

Field.Name: OpenClose
Field.Description: Indicates status of client position. O = Open C = Close N = None Orders wtih AccountType (581) = 3 (House Trader) are not required to specify OpenClose or may optionally specify a value of “N”. Otherwise, orders with AccountType (581) = 1 (Customer Account) must specify OpenClose.

Field.Name: CustOrderHandlingInst
Field.Description: Indicates the Execution Source Code on orders prior to their executions. Mandatory. A default value can be set using the ’Default Customer Order Handling Instruction’ port attribute. The port attribute is defaulted to Y (Electronic). Y = Electronic. (Default) W = Desk C = Vendor-provided Platform billed by Executing Broker (For complex) G = Sponsored Access via Exchange API or FIX provided by Executing Broker (For complex) H = Premium Algorithmic Trading Provider billed by Executing Broker (For complex) D = Other, including Other-provided screen (For complex)

Field.Name: AccountType
Field.Description: Type of account associated with the order 1 = Account is carried on customer side of the books. 3 = House Trader This field is required.

Field.Name: SideExecID
Field.Description: Available on an opt-in basis. Side unique version of the day-unique TradeID (1003).

Field.Name: FeeCode
Field.Description: Specific fee code associated with the trade. See the Fee Schedule for the respective market for possible values.

Field.Name: PartyID
Field.Description: The end-client responsible for the trade. Must be an identifier (4 uppercase letters) known to Cboe.

Field.Name: PartyIDSource
Field.Description: Must always be D (Proprietary / Custom Code)

Field.Name: PartyRole
Field.Description: Specifies the role of the party to the trade. At this time, only the following values are valid: 1 = ExecutingFirm (if used, must be set on both sides. Is not permitted for bilateral trades, except for Trade Confirmations) 3 = Client ID (Drop only) 6 = IntroducingFirm (Drop only) 7 = EnteringFirm (the party reporting the trade. Should not be used in the second leg, except when TradeHandlingInst (1123) = 0) 14 = GiveupClearingFirm (Drop only) 17 = ContraFirm (the party the trade is alleged against)

Field.Name: NoPartySubIDs
Field.Description: Drop only. Only relevant when PartyRole (452) = 3. The number of sub-parties involved. If set, must always be 1
